task.title: Keep a cookie in an environment variable

step.cmd: Sign in at the sign-in page. The server sets the sessions_pname cookie.
Save the sessions_pname cookie to the sessions_pname environment variable.
Sign out at the sign-out page, which replaces the cookie.
Load the cookie from the sessions_pname environment variable.
Open the cookie report, and check that it shows sessions_pname=signed-in.
